name: Safe-margin target dinks
summary: Two players at the non-volley-zone line dink cross-court into a target zone and count their own unforced errors (net or out).
setup: Both players at the non-volley-zone line; cones mark a target zone in the middle of each non-volley zone, away from the sideline
Cooperative dinks that clear the net by a comfortable margin and land in the target zone; no attacking shots
Each player counts their own errors: into the net, out, or outside the non-volley zone
success_criterion: In a set of 50 dinks, at most 3 of your own dinks are errors
safety_notes: Cooperative pace, no speed-ups. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Aiming at a central target with net clearance builds a safety margin, the usual cure for unforced errors (AN-04); the player counts exactly the errors AN-04 counts. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
